blocks.text: Bohat se bacteria sakht (harsh) halaat ke lambe arsay (periods) mein zinda reh sakte hain, is tarah ke woh khaas "resting" cells banate hain jinhen endospores kehte hain. Endospores moti deewar wale aur metabolically ghair-faal (inactive) yani dormant hote hain. Jis amal (process) se bacterium endospore banata hai use sporulation kehte hain.

blocks.title: Endospore aur sporulation
blocks.text: Endospore ek moti deewar wala, dormant resting cell hai jo bacterium ke andar banta hai taake woh na-mawafiq (unfavourable) halaat bardasht kar sake. Sporulation is ke banne ka amal hai. Sporulation bachao (survival) ka tareeqa hai, afzaish (reproduction) ka nahin: ek cell se ek hi endospore banta hai.

items: Jab bacterium ko na-mawafiq halaat milte hain to woh apna DNA replicate karta hai.
Cell membrane ek septum banati hai jo naye DNA ko cytoplasm ke chhote hisse ke saath alag kar deta hai.
Cell membrane naye DNA, cytoplasm aur septum ke gird dobara barhti hai, to ab naya DNA do membranes ke andar hota hai.
Vegetative (parent) cell ka DNA toot jata hai (disintegrates) aur poora cell sookhne (dehydrate hone) lagta hai.
Alag kiye gaye DNA aur cytoplasm ke gird dono membranes ke darmiyan peptidoglycan ki nai teh banti hai, aur us ke gird spore coat banta hai.
Yeh banawat pak kar endospore ban jati hai. Vegetative cell toot jata hai aur endospore azaad ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: Chhe marhale baen se daen: rod cell apna DNA replicate karta hai; septum ek copy ko alag karta hai; membrane us copy ko doosri membrane mein lapet leti hai; parent DNA toot jata hai; forespore ke gird peptidoglycan aur spore coat bante hain; parent cell toot kar endospore azaad hota hai.
blocks.caption: Bacterium mein endospore ka banna (sporulation) (Figure 2.4 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Marhala 1 mein rod-shaped cell apne circular DNA ki do copies ke saath hai. Marhala 2 mein ek sire ke qareeb septum ek copy ko thore cytoplasm ke saath band karta hai. Marhala 3 mein membrane us hisse ko lapet leti hai to woh do membranes wala ho jata hai (forespore). Marhala 4 mein parent ka DNA madham ho raha hai aur cell sookh kar sikur raha hai. Marhala 5 mein forespore ke gird moti peptidoglycan teh aur gehra spore coat hai. Marhala 6 mein parent cell ki deewar tooti hui hai aur andakar (oval) endospore azaad hai.

blocks.text: Endospore us waqt tak dormant rehta hai jab tak mawafiq (favourable) halaat wapas na aayen. Jab aate hain to endospore germinate hota hai aur ek naya vegetative cell banata hai.

blocks.title: Spore zinda kyun rehta hai
blocks.text: Do membranes, peptidoglycan ki nai teh aur spore coat DNA ko mehfooz rakhte hain, aur sookhne se metabolism ruk jata hai. Isi liye endospores garmi, khushki aur aise sakht halaat bardasht kar lete hain jo vegetative cell ko maar dete.

blocks.prompt: Sporulation ke waqiat ko tarteeb (order) dein: spore coat banta hai; DNA replicate hota hai; septum ek DNA copy ko alag karta hai; endospore azaad hota hai; parent DNA toot ta hai aur cell sookhta hai; doosri membrane naye DNA ke gird aati hai.
blocks.explanation: DNA replicate hota hai; septum ek copy ko thore cytoplasm ke saath alag karta hai; membrane us ke gird barhti hai to do membranes ban jati hain; parent DNA toot ta hai aur cell sookhta hai; peptidoglycan aur spore coat bante hain; endospore pakta hai aur parent cell tootne par azaad ho jata hai.

items: Endospores moti deewar wale, dormant resting cells hain jo bacteria ko sakht halaat mein zinda rakhte hain.

Sporulation: DNA replicate, septum ek copy alag karta hai, doosri membrane lapet leti hai, parent DNA toot ta hai aur cell sookhta hai, peptidoglycan aur spore coat bante hain, endospore pak kar azaad hota hai.
Mawafiq halaat wapas aane par endospore germinate ho kar naya vegetative cell banata hai.
